friday.reason: No calendar conflicts; 3+ hour window available 1:00–6:00 PM CT

saturday.reason: No calendar conflicts; full afternoon/evening available

sunday.reason: Church volunteering 8:30 AM–1:30 PM CT + CC Breakfast Alignment 3:30–4:00 PM CT conflicts with golf window. Available only after 4:00 PM (very constrained).

heat_streak_rationale: Last 5 days (Aug 17–21): all 5 days hit ≥95°F → heat_streak active. Default preferred start: 4:00 PM ($15/player).

top_options.rationale: Saturday 4:00 PM — ideal cost during heat streak, clear weather, no conflicts
Friday 4:00 PM — same heat-streak pricing, clear weather, but work-day constraint (+3 penalty)
Saturday 1:00 PM — early time during heat streak incurs +8 penalty for playing in peak heat; clear weather but hotter option
